name: jsqlsp
description: Language server integration for VS Code.

scripts.package: npm run python:bundle && webpack --mode production --devtool source-map --config ./webpack.config.js
scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.python:test: npm run python:bundle && uv run --group build --group test python scripts/run_python_tests.py

jsqlsp.cwd.description: Sets the working directory for jsqlsp. Supported variables: `${workspaceFolder}` (workspace root) and `${fileDirname}` (directory of the current file).

jsqlsp.args.description: Arguments passed in. Each argument is a separate item in the array.

jsqlsp.path.description: Optional executable and arguments to override the configured server command.

jsqlsp.importStrategy.description: Python mode only: choose where the Python server module is imported from.
enumDescriptions: Always use the bundled version of the Python server.
Use the Python server from the environment, falling back to the bundled version if it is unavailable.

jsqlsp.interpreter.description: Python mode only: optional Python executable and arguments used to launch the server.

jsqlsp.showNotifications.description: Controls when notifications are shown by this extension.
enumDescriptions: All notifications are turned off, any errors or warning are still available in the logs.
Notifications are shown only in the case of an error.
Notifications are shown for errors and warnings.
Notifications are show for anything that the server chooses to show.
